versions.changelog:
Initial release: Maturity-tailored CAPA consultant for small/less mature organizations.

- Introduces a dual-track CAPA solution (audit-compliant + practical execution) customized by organization maturity (A/B/C).
- Enforces 3 mandatory maturity assessment questions before solution recommendation.
- Standardizes a strict six-step CAPA process and six-section output, directly generating audit-ready reports (txt + md).
- Avoids jargon, distinguishes between correction and corrective action, and ensures step-by-step user guidance.
- Integrates knowledge base and links to adjacent quality tools (8D, 5Why, FMEA, etc.).
- Focuses on real-world implementation, not just documentation.
